sources.title: Dolphins place QB Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve; Kyle McCord in line for first start
sources.method: HEADLINE AND LINK ONLY. This article is linked from the official Week 10 injury report page (SRC-09). Its body was NOT read in this session, so only the published headline is reproduced and no detail is claimed.

depth_chart_news.quote: QB Carson Beck will start Sunday's game against the Rams, per head coach Mike LaFleur. This will be Beck's first career start in the NFL after he was selected in the third round of the 2026 draft.
depth_chart_news.depth_string_note: The article does not state whether Beck is the second or third quarterback on Arizona's roster. Left blank.

depth_chart_news.quote: QB Deshaun Watson will start Sunday against the Texans, the team announced Wednesday. Watson cleared concussion protocol before Cleveland's Week 9 game but was inactive as Shedeur Sanders got the start in the loss to New Orleans.
depth_chart_news.depth_string_note: The article does not state whether Watson is the second or third quarterback on Cleveland's roster. Left blank.

depth_chart_news.quote: K Harrison Butker will continue to handle kicking duties for Kansas City for its Week 10 game against the Falcons, head coach Andy Reid said. Butker missed a 51-yard field goal in Week 9 and is 12 of 19 on field goal attempts this season. The Chiefs signed Justin Tucker to their practice squad on Oct. 28.
depth_chart_news.depth_string_note: Not a replacement: the article states the incumbent continues. A backup (Justin Tucker) is on the practice squad.

depth_chart_news.quote: QB Kirk Cousins will start Sunday's game against the Packers, head coach Kevin O'Connell announced.
depth_chart_news.depth_string_note: The article does not state whether Cousins is the second or third quarterback on Minnesota's roster. Left blank.

depth_chart_news.quote: QB Lamar Jackson is expected to miss 6-10 weeks after undergoing surgery to repair his broken and dislocated thumb, coach Jesse Minter said in a statement.
depth_chart_news.depth_string_note: The incumbent starter is confirmed out. The article does not name Baltimore's Week 10 starting quarterback, so the replacement cell is left blank.

depth_chart_news.quote: Dolphins place QB Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve; Kyle McCord in line for first start
depth_chart_news.depth_string_note: Headline only (article body not read). The headline names Kyle McCord as in line for a first start, which is not the same as a confirmed start, so the starter cell is left blank.

depth_chart_news.quote: K Riley Patterson is signing with Baltimore following a workout and will kick for the Ravens during Monday's game against the Chargers, NFL Network Insider Mike Garafolo reported.
depth_chart_news.depth_string_note: A special-teams replacement is named for this game only.
